visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man wearing a black tank top and shorts walks through a spacious gym locker room area with wood-textured flooring. He stops when he notices a black shaker bottle and a piece of paper on the floor. (2) He squats down to pick up the note and a red 100-yuan bill. He reads the note, which is handwritten in Chinese. (3) The scene shifts to an office where the man is looking at CCTV monitors. He points at the screen showing a man in a white t-shirt accidentally knocking over his shaker bottle. (4) Back in the workout area, the man approaches the individual in white who is sitting on a weight bench. He places a hand on the other man's shoulder. (5) The man stands in front of gym equipment, holding a black shaker cup with a brand logo. He speaks directly to the camera with high energy while large text overlays appear. (6) He hands change in the form of coins to the man in white, then turns and walks away from the camera, exiting the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic dance music begins immediately with a clear four-on-the-floor beat. A young male voice narrating in Mandarin reads the text on the note with a casual and curious tone. (2) As the man checks the monitor, the voice becomes more energetic and focused, using colloquialisms like '來了來了來了' to build suspense. The background music maintains its steady, bright texture. (3) Upon confronting the person in white, the speaker's tone shifts to a professional sales pitch. He speaks rapidly but clearly, detailing a Golden Week sale for MYPROTEIN. (4) The speech rate increases further as he lists specific discount percentages and codes. The BGM ducks slightly to ensure clarity of the commercial information. (5) The narration concludes with a friendly, lower-arousal statement about returning change, accompanied by the faint sound of coins, before the music finishes.
